## Janaury 2025



### 20250103 Friday

In Tassie from 17 Dec through 16 Jan. Daddy made a booking issue, Mummy's car got left in Geelong. 

Day trip to Gunns Plains caves and Wings Wildlife with Nanny and Pooppy. Nanny did awesome in the caves. 
Daddy carried Theo whole way, up and down steep steps and ladder. Another day where I'm very happy 
to be dad-fit. 

Both boys had a great day, caves definitely worthwhile experience. Tour guide Ben is a rover and 
knows Amy. 

Both kids loved the fish at Wings splashing them when being fed. Theo's laugh was fantastic,

Both loved feeding the kangaroos as well. Theo didn't want to leave.

### 20250104 Saturday

Dinner at Little Sisters with live music. Kids played nicely with others. Walk home via the playground. 

### 20250105 Sunday

Went to Fossil Bluff early in the day. James loved the fossils. Theo loved lying down in puddles. 

Maddy, Rory, Matteo and Xander came over in the afternoon and kids played together really nicely. 

`r if(Make.Images){"![](Images/01_Jan/mitenedeabe230-815e-4777-a216-39ce8f2c6d8f.jpg){width=450px height=600px}"}`


### 20250107 Tuesday  

Moved to Adam and Brogan's at Cradle Mountain Hotel but had a quiet day otherwise. 



### 20250111 Saturday  

Went to Lobster Ponds with Granny and Pa, first time for all of us. Tour by Kevin Hyland, former mayor
of Winyard. 

### 20250112 Sunday

Church in Burnie. Kids enjoyed running around with Taz and Lexi's girls. 

Theo's language has been impressing eveeryone. Follows what being said really well, narrates the activities and plans
and loves to repeat the plan to confirm his understanding of what is happening. 

Theo is straigtening out, getting taller. looks like real little boy. getting heavier.

Did maths basic maths school stuff (subscrition given from Nick) yesterday with James, he is interested
and doing well. recognises numbers and counts well up to mid teens. 

Also played quacks again with Granny and James yesterday, added blue chips taking us up to 5 coulours. 
Not 100% sure James doesnt 'cheat; jsut a little but he is getting the logic and understadning the game quite 
well at least while concentration holds.

## February 2025



### 20250101 Saturday

`r if(Make.Images){"![](Images/02_Feb/20250201_191944.jpg){width=450px height=600px}"}`

Last night with Nanny poppy here helping look after James before school starts and doing lots of 
pre-house-move work in the garden and babysitting while we try too. 

Sitting here watching Theo use James keyboard, controlling it like a master, seriously playing piano
to boppy 'Ode to Joy', seems like musical prodigy, playing to beet.


### 20250222 Saturday

Theo talking about being exctied for moving house. Trying to understand, asking things like "will Nanny
and Poppy come to the new house? Will Granny and Pa come to the new house? and Phil will come to the new house?
And Pippa and Lizzie will come to the new house" in his gorgeous little voice.

Nailing potty training. 

James settled in well to school. Feels like a lovely environment. Watched Mr Bean last night and 
he was in stitches. Some more good chances to explain the jokes and what Mr Bean is doing wrong. I explained
the pun in the christmas episode where the girlfriend asked if he had the turkey on and mr bean says
something like "oh yes" when its really on his head. James thoguht it was hilarious when he understood it. 


### 20250225 Tuesday

At school drop of James did not want me to go trhough the gate. When we got to the gate he just turned
and pointed an said 'go back to the car'. We clarified the situation and I agreed he could go by
himself. On Friday he wanted me to sit and wait with him till the bell rang.

First night at Joeys (Scouts) tonight - scavenger hunt - James took to it with enthusiasm and seemed 
to do a good job of listening despite a litte bit of hyper energy. 

Sitting down to watch 'funny donkey' with family, I asked Theo if I could sit with him (in my spot).
He said carefully 'of course you can' in very lovely voice. Use of language is incredible.

## August 2025

### 20250813 Wednsday

James lovely at scouts last night. Nerf guns, did parade of second time. Well behaved, did sneak attacks 
on the flag more than shooting. 

Nanny and Poppy staying. Theo very cuddly at night on the couch with Nanny. 

Taking james to bed, read Monstosaurus, listened to a 'Bluey Club' and then went to put on the music 
and he asks for 'the music that made me go to sleep when I was a baby" (The Last Kingdom - Livstraedrir), 
not an uncommon occurrence. 
Love it that he gets special meaning from that song.  

James Minecraft improving. He started building his own house and then Evie came to help him. Love it 
that we can hae this cousin-like relationship and spend time doing Minecraft together from a distance.

## Octboer 2025

### 20251008 Wednesday  

James having great school holidays with Granny and Pa, Granny and Pa doing lots of activities at home. 

James playing lots of soccer matches with Granny and Pa. 

James and Daddy did parkrun on Saturday. Got Macccas afterwards and ate at Brad Haddin park, then played
our first game of bridge soccer. James loved it.


### 20251013 Monday

weekend spent at Bateman's Bay caravan park with Kate, Sam, Steph, Will, Nate, Aaliyah, Alyse, Astrid and
Fynn. Great time, kids loved it so much. 

Theo proactically refused to sleep as it was just so into everythign that was going on. He loved playing 
with the older kids, when we did try to get him to sleep / have a nap he was miserable and would girzzle 
"no no no" in a despairing tone - was heart breaking. When we were driving home he said he didnt want to, 
he wanted to go back to our cabin. 

James and Nate were like peas in a pod. Sleep pver attempt with Nate in our cabin failed - Lori thought
James and Nate might have scared each other somehow. 

Lori said one mum with a kid about Theo's age at the pool was amazed at Theo's language and how it used 
it with her - someone he didn;t even know.
